capabilities: Open local .ics files in a read-only inspection view
Parse VCALENDAR, VEVENT, VTODO, and VTIMEZONE components
List events grouped by date or component type
Filter events by text fields and date range
Fall back to raw source view when parsing is limited
disambiguation: Not a calendar sync, planning, or note-generation tool; it only inspects local .ics files read-only.
extras: Explicitly lists non-goals (no syncing, remote URLs, note generation, RSVP, or write-back) and states runtime code uses no network, clipboard, eval, or process APIs; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: deliberately stays file-inspection first: open a local .ics, inspect what is inside
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to inspect the contents of a local .ics file; it opens as plain text with no event lists, filters, or component summaries.

relations.evidence: ICS imports events from calendar/ICS URLs into Daily Notes.
Full Calendar provides a full calendar UI with read-only ICS/CalDAV remote calendars.
MemoChron focuses on calendar integration and event notes.
iCal generates iCal from vault tasks.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens local .ics calendar files with grouped event lists, filters, event details, recurrence and timezone warnings, and a raw source fallback.
